title: Chapter 225 Wang Shuo Has A Headache
content:
Chapter 225 Wang Shuo Has A Headache

Swallowing his saliva, Wang Shuo asked in some doubt: "Master Zach, if these resources are given to a player, won't it destroy the balance of the game?"

"Haha, young man, you are too naive. Those who don't have the strength to destroy the balance will not survive to the end."

"Improving strength also requires players to operate themselves. A three-year-old child holding a magic weapon must be able to control it himself!"

"Besides, these things, in my opinion, will not destroy your so-called balance. After all, someone already has these things!"

Wang Shuo was not feeling well. Someone already has them?

Will it be Dongshi Village?

"Master Zach, what do you think I should choose?"

"Okay, it seems that you have made a choice."

"A wise move!"

"You can open the treasure bag I gave you!"

Master Zach disappeared inexplicably.

"Hey, actually I want it!" Wang Shuo wanted to yell, but he felt that it was not decent!

Wang Shuo did not regret it!

Although he missed a snowball opportunity, he felt the preciousness of "freedom"!

The contract of selling oneself is not something that can be exchanged for these resources!

"Lord Zach, this shouldn't be! These resources of mine are enough for him to grow up, and he really refused?"

"Are you doubting me?" Lord Zach's momentum burst out, and the Lord of Sunset City suddenly realized that he was just a small chess piece.

But he still didn't give up.

"Lord Zach, I dare not, but, can I have a few words with Wang Shuo?"

"Humph, this is against the rules."

...

Wang Shuo heard Lord Zach's reminder and quickly took out three brocade bags, and found that the rope at the seal of one of the brocade bags was actually loose!

After opening it, there was a piece of animal skin inside.

There was a text written on it.

"To upgrade the town, you need the heart of the town (attack the system town to get the heart of the town)."

This reminder shocked Wang Shuo.

It not only made Wang Shuo happy, but also gave him a huge problem.

This setting is simply fanning the flames!

The last moment, the strength of the system town was strengthened, and the next moment, players were asked to attack it in order to upgrade the town.

This is really a big deal! Is the system town so easy to attack?

Soldiers of level 50 or 60 are well-trained and must be extremely powerful. There are also a large number of players in the town. If you attack them, it would be strange if they don't resist!

Wang Shuo suddenly felt a headache.

At this time.

"Woof, woof..." Da Huang's voice sounded beside Wang Shuo's ears.

Wang Shuo came back to his senses and saw that Da Huang was getting more and more powerful.

Throw him an energy crystal.

Da Huang swallowed it in one bite and licked his nose with his tongue, obviously feeling a little unsatisfied!

Seeing its tail wagging non-stop, Wang Shuo took out the dog tag he got from the Dragon King's underground palace and hung it directly on its neck.

It looks pretty good.

Wang Shuo had studied it for a long time before, but he had no idea about the function and use of this dog tag.

He thought, since the name is a dog tag, I wonder if there will be any changes when it is worn on the dog's neck.

So this move is not a whim!

But Da Huang, who wore the dog tag, suddenly felt creepy.

It was as if he had detected something terrible.

Wang Shuo observed for a long time, but nothing else happened. He even dripped Da Huang's blood and his own blood on the dog tag, but there was still no change.

Wang Shuo sighed and thought that Da Huang was a little uncomfortable with having an extra thing on his neck!

"This dog tag is just a decoration for you. See if it looks much more handsome!" Wang Shuo joked to Da Huang.

"Woof woof..."

Da Huang barked twice and ran out.

No longer paying attention to this stupid dog, Wang Shuo thought of the Dragon King's Underground Palace.

A month later, the Undead Army invaded again, and Wang Shuo had a headache again.

It seems that it is necessary to attack Nanshanji and upgrade the town in this month to stop the attack of the Undead Army.
